feeding_claim.verbatim: sourced from Angus cattle that graze freely on rich, nutritious grasslands.

resold_note: Also sells chicken, duck and seafood from a sourced freezer selection without naming the farms.
notes: AGW lists it as Animal Welfare Approved for beef (town North Canaan); farm site says Canaan. Checked 2026-11-15: homepage, FAQ and pork bacon page (the Scout also read the short ribs product page and shipping policy). Beef is pasture-raised Angus described as grazing grasslands, with no finishing statement, so the category is grass-fed. The FAQ and homepage say the beef, rose veal and pasture pork come from the Canaan farm, and the bacon page says the pork is raised in Canaan. Chicken, duck and seafood are a sourced freezer selection, so they are left out. Pickup in Canaan or FedEx shipping; the shipping policy names CT, MA, NY, NJ, NH, VT, southern Maine and eastern Pennsylvania, while the homepage and FAQ also name Rhode Island. A Certified Humane badge on the site was not checked on that certifier's listing, so it is not added.
